027 */@HistoryLogProps(

029    displayName = "CGM Data Sample",

032public class CgmDataSampleHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
033    
034    private int status;
035    private int value;
036    
037    public CgmDataSampleHistoryLog() {}
038    public CgmDataSampleHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int status, int value) {
039        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
040        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, status, value);
041        this.status = status;
042        this.value = value;
043        
044    }
045
046    public CgmDataSampleHistoryLog(int status, int value) {
047        this(0, 0, status, value);
048    }
049
050    public int typeId() {
051        return 151;
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * <table border="1">
056     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmDataSampleHistoryLog:</caption>
057     * <tr><td><code>status</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>value</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 19)</code></td></tr>
059     * </table>
060     */
061    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
062        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
063        this.cargo = raw;
064        parseBase(raw);
065        this.status = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
066        this.value = Bytes.readShort(raw, 19);
067        
068    }
069
070    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int status, int value) {
071        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
072            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(151, 0),
073            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
074            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
075            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(status),
076            new byte[7],
077            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(value)));
078    }
079    public int getStatus() {
080        return status;
081    }
082    public int getValue() {
083        return value;
084    }
085    
086}
